beginner.script: Welcome to your Beginner Chair Yoga session. Settle near a stable chair with both feet supported. Move gently within a range that feels comfortable today.

intermediate.script: Welcome to your Intermediate Chair Yoga session. Arrange your chair securely and follow each movement at your own pace. Keep your range comfortable and your breath steady.

advanced.script: Welcome to your Advanced Chair Yoga session. Keep your chair close and use the support shown. Choose a steady, comfortable range and pause whenever you need.

beginner.script: Your Beginner Chair Yoga practice is complete. Take one gentle breath and let your shoulders soften. There is no need to move right away; take the time you need.

intermediate.script: Your Intermediate Chair Yoga practice is complete. Let your breathing return to its natural rhythm. Notice how your body feels, and take your time before ending your practice.

advanced.script: Your Advanced Chair Yoga practice is complete. Let your breath settle at its natural pace. Pause for a moment, then finish your practice whenever you feel ready.
